build_gaussian_actor_network: build a GaussianFullyConnected actor network with custom hidden layer sizes and activations for continuous action spaces
build_actor_with_embeddings: build a GaussianFullyConnected actor with embedding bag concatenation by setting embedding_dim for sparse feature support
configure_normalization_options: configure batch norm, layer norm, or L2 normalization on the GaussianFullyConnected actor network builder
validate_sizes_activations: validate that the sizes and activations lists have matching lengths in GaussianFullyConnected post initialization
get_default_action_preprocessing: get the default action preprocessing type which returns CONTINUOUS_ACTION from the GaussianFullyConnected builder
